scope: Companion reanalysis of a finite upstream reference; no new MCMC, performance or convergence proof
reference_uncertainty: Report posterior MCSE, SD of ten chain means divided by sqrt(10), and SD of 200 nonoverlapping length-50 batch means divided by sqrt(200). Maximum is a sensitivity summary, not a rigorous bound on Monte Carlo error or bias.
replication: One upstream Stan generation with ten chains, each storing 1000 thinned correlated draws; neither 10000 independent experiments nor ten independent generation studies.
constant_functions: Retain them with undetermined reference uncertainty; no independent-binomial upper bound and no zero-error claim.
upstream_diagnostics: Compare reanalysis of raw alpha/beta with metadata from posterior 1.6.1; retain differences. No raw energy/divergence trajectories are supplied, so zero divergence is upstream-reported only.
future_inference: No function may be silently removed from future all-function assessment. This audit does not set final error thresholds or fit budgets.
memory_guard: At most 2000000 doubles in the R transport input; exact expected reference shape and all source hashes required.
